newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK 10-yr EF note average accepted yield 6.98 pct.
newsitem.headline: HK 10-yr EF note average accepted yield 6.98 pct.

text.p: The average accepted yield of the government's HK$500 million 10-year Exchange Fund Notes at Monday's tender was 6.98 percent, the Hong Kong Monetary Authority (HKMA) said.
This compares with the average accepted yield of 7.57 percent at the notes' inaugural tender on October 28.
The average tendered yield was 7.01 percent and the highest accepted yield was 6.99 percent.
The amount applied for the HK$500 million issue was HK$2.0 billion, against HK$7.26 billion at the previous tender, the HKMA said.
